_comment: ARK G431 12S CAN production EEPROM defaults. Same ARK vehicle policy as ARK_4IN1_F051 (2%/ms ramp, 1020 kV, 15° fixed, PWM-by-RPM) with input_type=DRONECAN_IN. Dedicated per-motor shunt enables a real 300 A current limit (current_limit eeprom 150 → PID target 30000 centiamps). Encoded by scripts/build_factory_image.py into the EEprom_t page (Inc/eeprom.h).

flash_map._comment: STM32G431 CAN map (Mcu/g431/ldscript_CAN.ld): 16 KiB BL, app @ 0x08004000, 2 KiB EEPROM @ 0x0801F800, 128 KiB total flash

settings.variable_pwm_meaning: 1 = PWM frequency scaled by RPM (configurator: PWM by RPM)
settings.current_limit_meaning: 150 → 300 A (PID target = limits.current * 2 * 100 centiamps). Requires USE_CURRENT_SENSE / dedicated shunt.
